{{Conjecture|legends}}
The [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Findsman/Legends|findsmen]] utilized a '''style of martial arts''', of which the tenets were not readily understood by the [[galactic community]]. A few of the moves were translated and described, however; ''Piercing Touch'' and ''Striking Mist''. The former, ''Piercing Touch'', was described as a powerful punch that was able to penetrate [[Bone/Legends|bone]], [[Chitin/Legends|chitin]], and various [[Armor/Legends|armors]].<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref> This move was demonstrated by [[Ooryl Qrygg]] when he punched a hole through [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] armor while stationed on [[Talasea]].<ref name="RS">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref> The other move, ''Striking Mist'', allowed the Gand to sneak in close to their opponent, so that the hits could not be parried or dodged.<ref name="AE" />
